candidateMeaning.en: Three bodies form a closed trine network. R4 records the repeated supportive geometry without treating ease as an automatic ability or result.
candidateMeaning.zh-Hans: 三个星体形成闭合三分相网络。R4 只记录重复的顺畅几何，不把顺畅直接等同能力或结果。

candidateMeaning.en: An opposition is connected to a third body by two squares. R4 records a concentrated tension network and identifies the geometric apex without assigning a fixed problem or fate.
candidateMeaning.zh-Hans: 一组对分相的两端同时与第三星体形成两个四分相。R4 记录集中张力网络与几何顶点，不把它定成固定问题或命运。

candidateMeaning.en: Four bodies form two oppositions and four squares. R4 records a closed high-tension geometry; no good/bad verdict is created.
candidateMeaning.zh-Hans: 四个星体形成两组对分与四个四分相。R4 只记录闭合的高张力几何，不产生吉凶判断。

candidateMeaning.en: A Grand Trine is linked to a fourth body through one opposition and two sextiles. R4 records the combined geometry without promising talent or opportunity.
candidateMeaning.zh-Hans: 一个大三角通过一组对分与两组六合连接第四星体。R4 记录组合几何，不保证天赋、机会或结果。

candidateMeaning.en: Two oppositions are linked by two trines and two sextiles. R4 records the alternating support/tension geometry without importing outcome claims.
candidateMeaning.zh-Hans: 两组对分通过两组三分与两组六合相连。R4 只记录支持与张力交替的几何，不引入结果断言。
